name: Lovable
freeTierNote: Daily build credits on free tier — check official limits.
priceBand: Free tier; Pro — check official pricing
bestFor: Non-engineers who need a working web app mock that can become a repo
skipIf: You are already fast in a real IDE
keyFeatures: GitHub export for handing off to engineers
limitations: Free message cap throttles exploration quickly
Generated apps require tests and cleanup before production
summary: Chat-to-app for people who do not want to name a folder. Engineers outgrow it. Founders use it to see the idea.
body: Lovable (and cousins like Bolt) compress the “can we see it?” phase. The danger is publishing the generated app as if it were a maintained product. Use it to get screens, then move the code to Git. Daily build credits on the free tier are the throttle; check the live pricing page before upgrading.
notes: Treat output as a prototype until tests exist
Check what the vendor stores from your prompts
Engineers should skip straight to Cursor or v0
